mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.7% over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.7%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering corporate revenue revisions downward and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in the last month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% yoy), the Federal Reserve tightens policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% yoy, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 (index 2017=100) over the past month signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in residential construction above 1600.0 thousand units in the last month indicates a strong housing market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST exceeds 1600.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.0%), wage growth accelerates and inflationary pressures mount, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in unemployment rate indicates dual economic stress (manufacturing contraction and labor market weakness), triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises in the last month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
